about.description: CSOPSAM is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking CSOP Samsung Electronics Daily Max (2x) Leveraged Product, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
